string.text: Named hunters who break off from you can come back in later hunts: by name, one rank higher each time, and they remember where you fought. Every named hunter starts at the rank Experienced. At the top rank, Legend, a hunter waits to come for you alone, as a boss. Off: names and ranks are random, as before, and no Legend comes. Default on.
Chance that a hunt is led by a hunter who broke off from you before (at most one a hunt). Default 35.

With AlifeTactics installed: who turns a hunter's rank into skill. AlifeTactics: its own rank curves (aim, vision, bursts) read the rank Nemesis gives him. Nemesis: the three sliders below, on top of what AlifeTactics still does by rank. Without AlifeTactics this list is not shown and Nemesis is used. Default AlifeTactics.
Nemesis rank effects: how many more of a named hunter's shots hit, for each rank above Experienced. Default 4.
Nemesis rank effects: how much faster and from how much farther a named hunter notices you, for each rank above Experienced. Needs the latest modded exes. Default 4.
Nemesis rank effects: how much longer a named hunter's bursts are, for each rank above Experienced. Needs the latest modded exes. Default 5.

Chance that a waiting Legend comes for you, rolled for each one every few in-game hours (below). He comes alone, as a boss: he fights to the death, and once killed his name is gone for good. Default 2.
In-game hours between the Legends' rolls. 0 = no Legend ever comes. Default 2.

In-game hours after any boss (the boss, the emission boss or a Legend) was last in the world, from the end of his hunt, during which no Legend comes. None comes while a boss is alive or a hunt's warning is out either. Default 12.
You killed every hunter in this save, and Nemesis let you go. Tick this and apply to bring the hunt back: every name returns, and the hunts start again.
